final: WITH ct AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS tot FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), ov AS (SELECT SUM(tot) AS s FROM ct WHERE tot IS NOT NULL), sh AS (SELECT ct.CustomerId, ct.tot, ct.tot * 1.0 / ov.s AS share FROM ct JOIN ov ON ov.s IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT sh.tot, sh.share, av.a FROM sh JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > av.a) SELECT AVG(tot) AS avg_total, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - a) AS avg_excess FROM kept
